verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own docs list native "workflows" among its capabilities, and it offers registrable event-type webhooks firing on booking triggers (created, paid, rescheduled, requested, cancelled) with payload templates sent to a subscriber URL. Its app directory also lists a Zapier app for automating on booking events, so event-driven background automation is first-party. However, the workflows feature appears only as a single word in llms.txt, and nothing shows AI-native or agent-driven automations that run autonomously; the webhooks and Zapier only feed external automation. Missing for 10: documented native workflow builder (triggers, actions, reminders), AI/agent-driven autonomous background tasks, scheduled or recurring automation configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
